McpServerDefinition.description: AFD360_Utilities demo: one tool that returns a Lead snapshot via the AFD360LeadSnapshot Apex invocable and renders it with the afd360LeadCard HXL widget.

tools.descriptionOverride: Return a snapshot of a Salesforce Lead (name, company, title, status, rating, source, email, phone, created date) by Lead Id (leadId) or name (leadName), displayed as a Lead card widget.

resources.description: Backs the widget-referencing CLT c__afd360LeadSnapshotResult; renderer.json maps $attrs.outputValues.lead.* to @widget/c/afd360LeadCard.
